messages:
Sam: Press-ready check — can we lock hero + 3 proof bullets + one media-ready quote, a 30s clip, and the webinar CTA in the next hour? Need media kit items for partner syndication.
Yuki: I'll take hero + media quote. Dropping 3 hero options + a short CTO quote placeholder in the doc in ~20.
Harper: I'll do the benchmark blurb, chart alt text, and attach raw CSV to assets. Planning to reference perf-harness:v4 and include a one-line test context. Will keep language per legal.
Toby: Webinar ops: we have a 12:30 PT live slot open for demo + 20m Q&A; also can pre-record a 30s clip for the media kit. Recommend live 12:30 for US/EMEA overlap. I'll pin the slot if marketing wants it.
PressBot: Automated: press distribution checklist uploaded -> /assets/press-checklist.pdf :white_check_mark: 
Mina (Legal): Quick heads up: use "up to" for comparative claims and add "in our internal benchmarks". For any customer-sounding quote in the media kit, clear attribution required. I can review the doc and quote copy by 3pm.
Yuki: Doc link: https://docs.google.com/xxx — hero chosen = Option B (short + punchy). Media quote placeholder: "Redwood made our inference predictable" (CTO attribution pending).
Harper: Bench draft: "median latency up to 3.0x faster, p95 up to 1.7x in our internal benchmarks (perf-harness:v4; 1x A100-equivalent; mixed batch; avg seq ~128)." Added chart alt text and attached perf CSV to the assets folder.
Toby: Calendly updated and 12:30 PT live demo pinned. Event title: "Redwood Launch: demo + Q&A". RSVP flow tested and confirmation email looks good.
Sam: HubSpot hidden fields (paste-ready):
```
hidden_fields:
  utm_source: press_email
  utm_campaign: press_launch_fall
  lead_route: press_inbound
  demo_slot: 12:30
  sf_tag: press_interest
```
Sam: Routing note: utm_campaign=press_launch_fall -> assign queue "press-inbound"; company_size>250 -> route to Enterprise AE; set sf_lead_flag=press_interest on submit.
Mina (Legal): Sign-off in doc for bench phrasing and CTAs. For the media quote add "(attribution pending)" until we get explicit permission; approved to proceed otherwise.
Sam: Locking CTAs: primary = "Register for launch demo"; secondary = "Request a dedicated eval (subject to qualification)". Proposed publish window = tomorrow 9:00am PT. If no flags by 4:00pm today I'll schedule publish and drop the media kit to the assets bucket. :rocket: 
Yuki: Leaving one alt social headline for the Twitter thread: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and sensible cost."
Harper: Added notes for partners: include asset bundle link and embed UTM examples for partner banners.
Toby: I'll run one end-to-end test after scheduling to confirm routing.
Sam: Thanks all — closing this thread once scheduled.
